# stream interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:streamInterval`](gmeow-streamInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/streamInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The time interval over which the stream was produced. Functional: the interval is constitutive of the stream's identity.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Stream`](../classes/gmeow-Stream.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bound a stream in time — the [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) over which its samples were produced — when the temporal extent is constitutive of which stream this is.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a single sample's timestamp (that lives on the sample itself) and avoid asserting two intervals on one stream — it is functional, so a different interval is a different stream.

### How to use

- Point the stream at one [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) covering its samples; individual sample timestamps still carry the fine-grained ordering, while this interval gives the whole run its bounds.

### Examples

- ex:roverTrack [`gmeow:streamInterval`](gmeow-streamInterval.md) ex:morningRun.
